paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B
model_annotation: The chart illustrates per-block “Sensitivity” values for the model (captioned “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B”), with each block’s sensitivity shown as a vertical bar and the bar color indicating one of two settings in the legend: 4‑Fbit (blue) and 2‑Fbit (green). The horizontal axis contains the categories as discrete block indices labeled “Block Index,” running in increasing order from 0 to 63 with major tick labels shown at 0, 15, 31, 47, and 63. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with labeled major ticks at approximately 10⁻⁵ and 10⁻⁴ (and minor log ticks between them); the plotted values span roughly from a few ×10⁻⁶ at the low end up to around 2×10⁻⁴ at the high end. Most blocks are represented by green (2‑Fbit) bars, which generally fall in the ~3×10⁻⁶ to ~2×10⁻⁵ range early on and cluster around ~1×10⁻⁵ to ~2×10⁻⁵ through the mid-range of indices, while several specific indices are colored blue (4‑Fbit), including a short run around the high 20s/low 30s and multiple bars in the later indices; these blue bars are around ~2×10⁻⁵ near the early blue segment and rise to higher values in the final portion, culminating in the tallest blue bars near indices around 61–63 at roughly ~1×10⁻⁴ to ~2×10⁻⁴. The bars are not sorted by height and appear in natural index order, and there is no stacking or side-by-side grouping within an index (one bar per block), with no special outlines or annotations beyond the legend and axis labeling.
